Purpose.summary: Wave-by-wave metric matrix and runtime evidence plan for pipeline latency improvements.
Purpose.scope: W1 FastLatencyRelief, W2 LocalFirstCriticalPath, W3 IncrementalStreamingArchitecture

GlobalMeasurementPolicy.rule-1: Capture baseline metrics before each wave starts and compare against the same scenario after the wave is verified.
GlobalMeasurementPolicy.rule-2: Use the same device routing, language pair, phrase set, and logging level during before/after comparisons.
GlobalMeasurementPolicy.rule-3: Prefer p50 and p95 values over single-run samples.
GlobalMeasurementPolicy.rule-4: Track both success-path latency and degraded-network fallback behavior.
GlobalMeasurementPolicy.rule-5: Do not accept latency improvements that materially reduce transcript completion reliability.

metric.name: stt_final_ms
metric.definition: Elapsed time from audio delivery into STT session until final transcript emission for an utterance.

metric.name: translate_ms
metric.definition: Elapsed time from translation worker start until translated text is emitted.

metric.name: tts_ms
metric.definition: Elapsed time for TTS synthesis once translated text is available.

metric.name: total_ms
metric.definition: Total end-to-end latency reported by the current utterance path.

metric.name: provider_used
metric.definition: Provider that produced the accepted translation result on the active path.

metric.name: time_to_first_audio_ms
metric.definition: Elapsed time until first translated audio chunk is ready for playback.

metric.name: stable_partial_lead_ms
metric.definition: Time gap between first stable partial emission and final transcript emission for the same utterance.

metric.name: queue_drop_count
metric.definition: Number of stale translation or TTS jobs dropped or canceled by queue control.
metric.source: stale job dropped/canceled markers in engine trace

scenario.name: ShortPhraseOutgoingRUEN
scenario.goal: Measure response time on a short Russian phrase translated to English.

scenario.name: ShortPhraseIncomingENRU
scenario.goal: Measure response time on a short English phrase translated to Russian.

scenario.name: DegradedNetworkFallback
scenario.goal: Observe fallback behavior when Groq or Deepgram are slow, blocked, or unavailable.

scenario.name: LongSentencePartialLead
scenario.goal: Measure stable partial lead and first-audio lead for incremental mode.

Wave.Goal: Reduce hot-path latency in the current cloud-centric flow.

AcceptanceTargets.target: Short phrase p50 improves by at least 300 ms versus baseline after endpointing change.
Degraded-network p95 improves by at least 30 percent versus serial fallback baseline.
No regression in end-to-end completion reliability while reducing latency.

Wave.Goal: Establish a local-only ru/en critical path for transcript, translation, and TTS.

AcceptanceTargets.target: ru/en hot path uses `local_mt` instead of Groq, LiteLLM, or Yandex.
Short phrase translation variance is lower than the cloud fallback baseline.
p50 total latency approaches local-path target without requiring external API availability.

Wave.Goal: Reduce perceived latency through stable partials, queue control, and early playback.

AcceptanceTargets.target: Stable partial appears meaningfully earlier than final transcript on long phrases.
Playback begins before full-utterance completion on long phrases.
Stale jobs are controlled explicitly rather than accumulating invisible backlog.

commands.command: Run dual pipeline with reproducible short and long phrase sets

collection-notes.note: Use the same machine, device routing, and model configuration before and after each wave.
Record at least 10 short-phrase samples per direction for p50 and p95 calculations.
Record at least 5 long-phrase samples for stable-partial and first-audio measurements once W3 begins.
